A '''special-missions force''' of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] was hired by [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]] in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]]. They answered directly to the [[Office of the Chief of State]], and served officially as part of Daala's security detail. Several of the bounty hunters took part in such events as the arrest of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], the hunt for the [[Force psychosis|psychotic]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Valin Horn]], and the [[Raid on the Armand Isard Correctional Facility|raid]] on the [[Armand Isard Correctional Facility]]. After Horn's rampage through [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Business district (Coruscant)|business district]], the select [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunters were mentioned in multiple newscasts as Daala's special-missions force; however, none of them were named. [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] conducted research on several of the hunters.

Among their members were such bounty hunters as [[Dhidal Nyz]], [[Kaddit]], [[Hrym Mawarr]], [[Vrannin Vaxx]], and [[Jesmin Tainer|Zilaash Kuh]], as well as a [[Unidentified Human bounty hunter (Valin Horn)|tall blonde woman]] and a [[Unidentified pilot (Valin Horn)|pilot]].
